name: Connections live in ONE place
prose: the Settings view has no endpoint, key, model, TEST or save controls at all; the connection wizard owns every one of them. A key can no longer be typed in two places that disagree, and "which surface did I configure this on" stops being a question. Vision is switched per workspace from the sidebar/pane context menu — the same menu that connects it — and moves the same `vision` setting the engine reads.
invariant: The Settings view carries no endpoint, key, model, TEST or save controls at all; the connection wizard owns every one.
